_comment: Frigate NVR overlay. EDIT the bind 'source' paths to match your host. See profiles/README.md. shm 'size' scales with camera count/resolution.
_comment_tz: Timezone via env (Frigate honors TZ). Bind-mounting /etc/localtime is avoided because OpenWrt usually has no such file, and a missing bind source makes ujail fail the whole container. Set TZ to your zone.
_comment_devices: GPU + Coral passthrough goes in the uxcd registry 'devices' field (/etc/uxc/<name>.json), NOT only here: the registry adds the device node AND the cgroup device-allow rule that a bundle mount alone does not grant. Add what you have, e.g. "devices": ["/dev/dri", "/dev/apex_0"] for an M.2/PCIe Coral, or "/dev/bus/usb" for a USB Coral (it re-enumerates after firmware upload, so pass the bus). See docs/configuration.md.
_comment_web_ports: Frigate's web UI is port 5000. docker2uxc auto-fills it into the registry 'web_ports' from the image's EXPOSE, so the LuCI overview shows a click-through icon - just add a label (e.g. "Frigate") there. Ports 8554 (RTSP) and 8555 (WebRTC) are not web UIs and are intentionally left out.
_comment_mounts: EDIT every bind 'source' to your host paths. ALL sources must exist on the host or ujail fails to start the container. /dev/dri is for VAAPI; remove it if the host has no GPU.
